column1: # xbios-ptr-r1.tsv -- DUMPBIOS, structures behind a returned pointer
# (TASK/TOOL16): the IOREC records behind Iorec(0/1/2), the keyboard flush
# through Iorec(1)'s pointer, and the MPB/MD of Getmpb, against EmuTOS
# pointer".  The !layout lines are copies of the tosdump-layout blocks in
# docs/api/structures/iorec.md and md.md -- layoutcheck refuses this table
# if one differs.  r:<layout> reads the structure behind the returned
# pointer, 0:<layout> the one in buffer 0, one 64-bit slot per field; a
# pointer the follow rule refuses is not read.  !write return admits +put,
# which writes one field through the pointer of the case right before it.
# A separate table, so bios-r1.tsv and xbios-chardev-r1.tsv and their
# references stay as they are.  One table per round: the case id is the
# physical line number and the dump header carries the CRC of this file, so
# ---- Iorec(dev): bios/xbios.c:336-348; the records: docs/api/xbios/0e-iorec.md, F1
# ---- the flush io->ibufhd = io->ibuftl in user state, then Bconstat(2) (XBIOS01; bios/ikbd.c:242)

column5: Iorec(1): the pointer the flush writes through
Iorec(1) read back after the flush: head == tail
